page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates solid capabilities across various workloads. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 (specifically avx512f and avx512_vnni) and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. This hardware enablement is reflected in its Passmark memory score of 2775.46, which ranks in the strong tier. Large-block memory bandwidth reaches 153.99 GB/sec for read operations and 69.91 GB/sec for write operations. Multi-core performance is highlighted by a Geekbench multi-core score of 13329.0 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 31013.7.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.g7.8xlarge offers a stable environment for general-purpose enterprise applications. It is well-suited for tasks such as static web serving, which achieved a throughput of 33.08 GB/sec in testing, and database operations, showing 31.4 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. Additionally, the instance performs strongly in lightweight machine learning tasks, achieving 304.16 tokens per second for text generation on a small 135M LLM model. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a resource-dense choice for compute-and-memory balanced workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators.
